verdict.rationale: Spline is a cloud SaaS design tool with an MCP server and APIs, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows API keys, tokens, scopes or least-privilege permissions for agents. The bundled MCP server connects local clients with 'nothing to install or configure', and no credential-scoping mechanism is described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
